text:
elena_benefits: Hey team — FYI I noticed in today's run that the PTO subsidy we paid out for Q1 relocation (payrun id 2026-03-RL) was flagged as 'bonus' and taxed at supplemental rate. Can someone confirm?
maria_payroll: Oh no. Can you paste the payrun id and employee ID? I can look it up.
elena_benefits: payrun 2026-03-RL, emp 54219. Looks like code `REL_PTO_SUB` got mapped to payroll code `BONUS_SUPP`.
adam_eng: I saw my net pay drop and thought it was weird. Thanks for flagging. I didn't get any pre-notice.
maria_payroll: Got it. I see the mapping. Our import mapping file had a line change last week during a quick fix. `REL_PTO_SUB -> BONUS_SUPP`. That was unintended.
sasha_peopleops: @maria_payroll what are the options? Is this reversible or will it affect W-2?
maria_payroll: Short term: we can run an off-cycle correction for emp 54219 to reclassify the $1,250 as non-taxable reimbursement (if backed by receipts), which will adjust net pay and tax withholdings for the period. Longer term: we need a mapping rollback and a sweep to find others.
elena_benefits: We have receipts for all approved relocations (linked in HR case #7892). This meets the non-taxable reimbursement policy.
adam_eng: Appreciate the quick action — does this mean I'll get a debit/credit on next paycheck or separate check?
maria_payroll: We'll issue an off-cycle refund check for the tax delta and post an adjusting payroll to correct year-to-date taxable wages. If the correction happens after year-end cutoff it may require a W-2c.
sasha_peopleops: Can we estimate timeline? Employee asks about taxes for filing.
maria_payroll: I'll run the off-cycle tomorrow (Tue) AM. Refund issued same day. Sweep search for similar misclassifications across the last 3 payruns will take until Thursday. If we find more, we'll batch corrections.
elena_benefits: Can you drop the list into this thread when ready so I can cross-check policy docs? Thx.
payroll-bot: Automated check: searching payruns 2026-02, 2026-03, 2026-04 for code `REL_PTO_SUB` mapped to taxable codes... 5 matches found across 4 employees.
maria_payroll: Thanks bot. I'll add those to the correction queue.
adam_eng: Quick Q — will my estimated taxes be messed up for 2026 filing if this isn't fixed before I file?
maria_payroll: If you file before we issue W-2c, you'll need to report taxes as withheld (we will provide letters and corrected docs). We'll prioritize to avoid W-2c where possible.
sasha_peopleops: @elena_benefits @maria_payroll flagging for audit trail: please add case notes and link approvals. Also loop @legal if we need formal communication templates.
elena_benefits: Will do. I've added notes to HR case #7892 and pinged legal.
maria_payroll: Action items: 1) Run off-cycle correction for emp 54219 (tomorrow AM). 2) Sweep results + build correction queue (by Thu). 3) Notify affected employees with remediation steps and expected timing (I will draft templates).
adam_eng: Thanks all. Please cc me when it's done.
elena_benefits: cc'ed. Sorry for the surprise — we'll tighten the import test to catch mapping regressions. :face_with_head_bandage:
